text:
sara (recruiter): Quick FYI: Offer accepted by Maya Patel (L3 Platform Eng). She asked about the background check timeline and whether ID verification must be in-person. Can ops advise?

juan (hiring mgr): We'll need her badge before desk access; if clearance takes a few days that's fine but we want to run the code pairing as scheduled next Wed. Any workaround for the interim?

harmit (people-ops): Two paths: 1) Remote e-ID verification via our vendor (IDVerify) can complete same-day if candidate can do a 15min live session, OR 2) fingerprinting at an authorized test center (longer lead). Which does she prefer? Also need signed consent + DOB + full legal name.

sara (recruiter): I asked Maya. She prefers remote e-ID but needs confirmation that we don't share sensitive data and that the background check vendor is accredited. She also asked whether she must sign the NDA before the remote ID step.

hr-screening-bot: Vendor: IDVerify (SOC2, ISO27001). Standard background check consent required. NDA not required to start ID verification but recommended before technical pairing. Link to consent form: https://redwood-internal/hr/consent/maya-patel (internal).

security-bot: Temporary guest access policy: after e-ID completes and background check consent is recorded, we can issue a day badge limited to interview areas. Full building badge requires completed background check result (2-5 business days). If candidate prefers, we can do on-site supervised access with escort same day.

it-support-bot: Note for pairing session: If NDA must be signed before we can share internal repos, we can gate repo access for a single-day token. Otherwise candidate can do pairing without repo access (share screen).

sara (recruiter): Maya ok with remote e-ID. I'll send the consent link and vendor info. She also asked for an expense note: if vendor requires an ID printing fee or in-person travel, will Redwood reimburse?

harmit (people-ops): We reimburse reasonable expenses (transit to vendor, fingerprint fee up to $40). Candidate should keep receipts and submit to expenses@redwood.com with project code HIRING-REIMB. I'll add a short policy blurb in the invite.

juan (hiring mgr): Two operational asks: 1) Please add "no recordings" to the pairing invite and 2) put a note that candidate prefers remote e-ID and needs badge-ish access if remote e-ID not completed by 10am day-of.

hr-screening-bot: Consent recorded at 2026-09-02T09:12Z (placeholder). Background check initiated. Vendor estimate: 48-72 hours for standard checks, may vary by region.

candidate-bot: Maya confirmed she completed the e-ID session and uploaded passport. She signed consent and prefers to sign the NDA electronically later today.

security-bot: Temp day badge approved once vendor callback confirms identity match. We'll issue a QR guest pass to candidate email for office check-in. Escort optional per candidate preference.

harmit (people-ops): I've updated the calendar invite: added consent link, expense instructions, "candidate completed e-ID" note, and a short privacy blurb. Also attached NDA link to sign before repo access: https://redwood-internal/legal/nda (internal).

sara (recruiter): All set. Maya will sign NDA today and join pairing Wed 10:00am PT. Reopen if background check flags or if vendor needs more docs. Thanks team :thumbsup:

juan (hiring mgr): Thanks folks, appreciate the clear runbook.

it-support-bot: Reminder: create a one-day GitHub invite token post-NDA if needed; please ping me 24h before.

harmit (people-ops): Closing logistics — keeping thread open for any vendor flags.
